exactClaims.unitaryNoGo: For a fixed lossless coherent transfer U, trace distance and projective angle are preserved; repeated U cannot create an attracting selector fixed point.
exactClaims.passiveLinearNoGo: For a fixed passive transfer M, any generic projective attraction is controlled by unequal singular/eigenvalue magnitudes and is therefore ordinary filtering, loss or gain selection.
exactClaims.affineType: R(rho;Y)=m rho+(1-m)Y Tr(rho) is a linear trace-preserving replacement channel on density/covariance matrices, not a linear map on coherent pressure vectors.

ensembleChannel.protocol: On each independently indexed shot or time slot, route the loop-returned field with probability m and inject the independently calibrated Y preparation with probability 1-m; tomograph the ensemble covariance after preserving branch labels for audit.
ensembleChannel.limitation: individual coherent shots do not contract; only the ensemble covariance does

singleTrajectoryOption.protocol: measure the state, compute the declared update, and actively synthesize the next input, or couple to a separately characterized nonlinear reservoir
singleTrajectoryOption.limitation: this is an engineered feedback dynamics and must not be described as spontaneous selection

records: complex pressure vector on every shot
singular values of every deterministic block
coherence and population perturbations about Y
discriminator.decision: Affine replacement scales every traceless covariance perturbation by m. A matched passive filter has log singular-value ratio ln(3), transmits the orthogonal input with power 1/9, and scales coherence and population anisotropically. Loss-matched tomography separates them.

sourcePrecedents.boundary: Z3 pump cycles cross band degeneracies and do not implement repeated affine selection
endpoint phase classes do not supply selector dynamics

verdict.physicalFirewall: The emulator tests typing and detector discipline; it does not evidence spontaneous symmetry breaking or new physics.
